title: Implement image and audio generation roles

context.summary: Make image-generation and audio-generation real @mindory/llm operations.
context.background: Generation roles must have typed operation contracts and smoke surfaces even if not used by default document processing.

in: Implement image and audio generation provider contracts in @mindory/llm.
Support OpenAI-compatible, local HTTP and local-command adapters where configured.
Add audit usage, duration, provider and model records.
Add CLI smoke commands for generation diagnostics.
Remove TASK-99-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.
out: Adding product workflows that require generated media by default.

acceptance_criteria: Image generation returns typed media outputs with metadata and audit records.
Audio generation returns typed media outputs with metadata and audit records.
Disabled generation roles fail with the standard disabled-role behavior.
CLI smoke commands can exercise fake-compatible generation providers.

manual_checks: Confirm generation roles remain opt-in and are not required by default MVP flows.

risks: Generated media can be large and must use bounded payload handling.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
